label: D1 after a1->S1, strongest when the trial before visited S2, grows with episode trial
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -3) == 1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == -9) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == -1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == -1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * ep_trial
explanation: Sparse feature (nonzero on 2.9% of steps), active only at D1. Its magnitude is set by the previous trial: it fires only when the previous trial was a1 and reached S1 (common). The reward on that trial makes almost no difference (a reward x ep_trial term got a near-zero weight). Within a1->S1, it is largest (~1.3) when the trial before that visited S2, mostly a1->S2 rare (so the first common S1 visit after an S2 visit), and it decays as the run of S1 visits gets longer (~0.9 after two, ~0.4 after three). All of this scales roughly linearly with the episode trial, so it is near zero early in the episode. After any S2 visit or an a2 choice it is ~0. On the first window trial (previous trial unknown), the belief log-odds that S1 is good stands in for this history. Observed-only, 8 terms: dev R^2 beyond timing 0.44, test 0.43. That is above the additive all ceiling of 0.34 (all observed 0.25) because the history-by-episode interaction is multiplicative. The earlier pass used the policy logit (leaning a1); the observed-only state-sequence description loses nothing here and does better. GO and D2 are always zero.
